chunks: And in the narration of Al-Bazanti:
"The mut'ah (compensatory gift) for a divorced woman is an obligation."

key_terms.الْبَزَنْطِيِّ: Al-Bazanti, the transmitter to whom this narration is attributed
key_terms.رِوَايَةِ: narration; a reported version of the hadith
key_terms.مُتْعَةَ: the compensatory gift given after divorce

ai.seo_question: Is the mut'ah compensatory gift for a divorced woman obligatory in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This report states a legal ruling that the compensatory gift given to a divorced woman is obligatory. It relates to family law and establishes the binding nature of this entitlement in the case under discussion.
